newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain-Soy offers mostly lower, corn mixed.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain-Soy offers mostly lower, corn mixed.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers weakened in the deferred positions on Wednesday while soft red winter wheat values rose, dealers said.
One dealer noted the volatility of the August/November soybean spread on the Chicago Board of Trade appeared to continue to pressure values. The movement in soybeans also improved, he said.
On the export front, State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp on Wednesday bought a combined shipment of 18,000 tonnes U.S. corn and 12,000 U.S. soybean from Zennoh at a tender.
Also, Jordan was tendering on August 12 for 100,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat. One shipment of 50,000 tonnes is for October delivery and the rest for November, European traders said.
Morocco was seeking a total of 120,000 tonnes of optional-origin wheat to be delivered in August and September, European traders said. Offers were due August 4.
